_doc: Rule constants, rules v0.5. Keep tunable numbers here, not in code.
_formation_doc: [row, lane] on the hero board; row 0 = front, lane 0 = the players' left (shared by both boards)
_formations_doc: Formations the party may choose at the start of a run (RunRequest.FORMATION). 'back_row': as far back as four heroes fit, three in the back row and the Fighter in the middle in front of them

battle._round_cap_doc: Digital engine only: a battle still running after this many rounds ends as a draw. In a run the enemies withdraw: no loot or XP, no wipe (ruling #65)

provoke.ties: last token to arrive is on top

empty_deck: finish the battle with your hand, then sit out battles until a campfire

camping._wandering_doc: After the reset, one hero (party's choice) flips the top of their fresh deck; monsters on a skill value at or below this. No loot, no XP (rulings #60, #61)

walking._doc: For each tile the party walks into (to a campsite, to another room's doorway, or out when evicted), the leading hero flips; monsters on a skill value at or below this, fought in that room. No loot, no XP (RULES §8 Walking through the Hut)

_leader_order_doc: The hero leading the party: an unspotted trap springs on the first standing hero in this order (ruling #55); the walking check is flipped by the first who can flip (open question #78)
